EDITS:
WHY: which index backs search is listed under Developer decides, and the recommendation settles it.
The files expansion alone would be additive, but it follows from that choice.
Once the developer answers, reopening T1 with shelf/search_index.py is additive.
BRIEF: The plan leaves open which index makes catalog search fast. A word map cannot find text inside words, which the milestone requires; sorted title lists only help prefixes; a trigram map finds any substring of three or more characters and scans only for shorter queries. Recommended: a trigram map in a new shelf/search_index.py, the only option that keeps search returning exactly what the old scan did.
